ViewObject.Name: PreviousProceduresRVO
ViewObject.SQLQuery:
SELECT decode(folder.sequence_number, NULL, '',(folder.year || '/' || folder.sequence_number || '/' || decode(folder.folder_type, 2, 'حبس', 3, 'غرامة', 5, 'أمن دولة حبس', 6, 'أمن دولة غرامة') || '/' || ents.entity_name)) AS inventory_number, acts.IS_ACTIVE AS F_ACTIONS_ACTIVE , --('O'=Approve) --('X' = Reject) acts.EXPATRIATE_APPROVAL AS F_EXPATRIATE_APPROVAL , --('O'=Approve) --('X' = Reject) acts.EXP_APPROVAL_DATE AS EXPATRIATE_APPROVAL_DATE , acts.EXP_EXPIR_REQUEST AS EXP_EXPIR_REQUEST , --('Y' = EXPIR_REQUEST(167))
( select decode(folder.sequence_number, NULL, '',(fol.year || '/' || fol.sequence_number || '/' || decode(fol.folder_type, 2, 'حبس', 3, 'غرامة', 5, 'أمن دولة حبس', 6, 'أمن دولة غرامة') || '/' || ents.entity_name)) from exc_folder_data fol where fol.id = acts.merged_to ) AS merged_to,
( select parr.PARTY_FULL_NAME from PAR_PARTIES parr where parr.id = (select ress.PARTY_ID from COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES ress where ress.id = (select fol.RES_PARTY_ID from exc_folder_data fol where fol.id = acts.merged_to) )) as party_name_to, ( select decode(folder.sequence_number, NULL, '',(fol.year || '/' || fol.sequence_number || '/' || decode(fol.folder_type, 2, 'حبس', 3, 'غرامة', 5, 'أمن دولة حبس', 6, 'أمن دولة غرامة') || '/' || ents.entity_name)) from exc_folder_data fol where fol.id = acts.merged_with ) AS merged_with,
( select parr.PARTY_FULL_NAME from PAR_PARTIES parr where parr.id = (select ress.PARTY_ID from COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES ress where ress.id = (select fol.RES_PARTY_ID from exc_folder_data fol where fol.id = acts.merged_with) )) as party_name_with,
(select PAR_POLICE.PAR_YEAR || '/' || PAR_POLICE.POLICE_NUMBER || '/' || CAS_TYPE2.NAME|| '/' || POLICE.ENTITY_NAME AS BUSINESS_CASE_NUMBER
from PAR_POLICE_AUTHORITY_REPORT PAR_POLICE , BUSINESS_CASE_TYPE CAS_TYPE2 ,ENTITY POLICE
where PAR_POLICE.ORIGIN_ENTITY = POLICE.ID AND CAS_TYPE2.ID = PAR_POLICE.BUSINESS_CASE_TYPE
and PAR_POLICE.id =
( select parr.PAR_ID from PAR_PARTIES parr where parr.id = (select ress.PARTY_ID from COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES ress where ress.id = (select fol.RES_PARTY_ID from exc_folder_data fol where fol.id = acts.merged_with) )) ) as merged_with_bc ,
(select PAR_POLICE.PAR_YEAR || '/' || PAR_POLICE.POLICE_NUMBER || '/' || CAS_TYPE2.NAME|| '/' || POLICE.ENTITY_NAME AS BUSINESS_CASE_NUMBER
from PAR_POLICE_AUTHORITY_REPORT PAR_POLICE , BUSINESS_CASE_TYPE CAS_TYPE2 ,ENTITY POLICE
where PAR_POLICE.ORIGIN_ENTITY = POLICE.ID AND CAS_TYPE2.ID = PAR_POLICE.BUSINESS_CASE_TYPE
and PAR_POLICE.id =
( select parr.PAR_ID from PAR_PARTIES parr where parr.id = (select ress.PARTY_ID from COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES ress where ress.id = (select fol.RES_PARTY_ID from exc_folder_data fol where fol.id = acts.merged_to) )) ) as merged_to_bc ,
( SELECT to_char(dates.hearing_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') FROM court_circles_dates_hearing dates WHERE dates.id = proc.court_circle_dates_hearing_id ) hearing_date, ( SELECT dates.id FROM court_circles_dates_hearing dates WHERE dates.id = proc.court_circle_dates_hearing_id ) hearing_date_id, folder.sequence_number, acts.veto_status, folder.police_station_entity_id, folder.year, folder.folder_type, decode(folder.repeated_flag, 'N', 'غير مكرر', 'Y', 'مكرر') repeated_flag, folder.id AS folder_id, res_part.id res_party_id, folder_types.folder_name, proc.advance_payment_amount, proc.advance_payment_date, folder.imprisonment_start_date, folder.imprisonment_end_date, proc.procedure_date, acts.action_type procedure_type, decode(proc.CAPACITY_TYPE , 1,'بشخصة',2,'توكيل',3,'نيابة عامة' , 8,'هيئة قضايا الدولة' , 9,'مدعى بالحق المدنى' ) as CAPACITY_TYPE, proc.CAPACITY_TYPE AS CAPACITY_TYPE_ID , proc.id, ( SELECT to_char(dates.hearing_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') FROM court_circles_dates_hearing dates WHERE dates.id = proc.court_circle_dates_hearing_id ) || ' ' || ents.entity_name date_ent_reservation, action_types.id acts_type_id, action_types.name acts_types_name, action_types.mapping_file_types, res_part.party_id, res.business_case_id, ( SELECT par.party_full_name FROM par_parties par WHERE par.id = res_part.party_id ) party_full_name, res.id reservation_id , proc.fees_type_id, (select COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_ID from court_bc_hearing_res_parties where id = proc.res_party_id ) new_reservation_id , proc.res_party_id new_res_party_id, ( SELECT name FROM exc_lkp_fees_types WHERE id = proc.fees_type_id -- AND acts.action_type = 7 ) sadad_type, ents.id ent_id, proc.created_by, ( SELECT nvl(SUM(decisions.penalty_amount), 0) FROM exc_court_bc_charges_parties parties, exc_court_bc_charge_decisions decisions WHERE parties.charge_decision_id = decisions.id AND parties.res_party_id = folder.res_party_id ) hasr_penalty_amount, proc.reason_date reason_date ,proc.NUMBER_PAID FROM exc_folder_data folder, court_bc_hearing_res_parties res_part, court_bc_hearing_reservation res, exc_lkp_folder_types folder_types, exc_folder_procedures proc, exc_lkp_action_types action_types, exc_folder_actions acts, entity ents, exc_lkp_action_types acts_types WHERE folder.folder_type = folder_types.id AND folder.id = acts.folder_record_id AND acts.procedure_id = proc.id AND acts.action_type = action_types.id AND res_part.id = folder.res_party_id AND res_part.court_bc_hearing_res_id = res.id AND ents.id = folder.police_station_entity_id AND acts_types.id = acts.action_type AND acts.DELETED_FLAG = 'N'
ORDER BY proc.id asc

ViewAttribute.Name: Switcher
ProcedureTypeSadadName
ViewAttribute.TransientExpression: if(SadadType != null) return ActsTypesName +' '+ SadadType; else return ActsTypesName;
